## Installation

You can install the development version of zupkpmx from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zupkpmx")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(zupkpmx)
## basic example code
```
